critical_code_review_comments: routes/economy.py list_vehicle_categories: counts include ALL vehicles including those with category_id set to an INACTIVE category id (they end up in the 'other' catch-all as expected), but if you deactivate a category (active:false via admin PUT), the vehicles still carry that category_id — GET /api/vehicle-categories/{inactive_id} returns 404 while the vehicles bucket into 'other'. This is consistent but could surprise admins editing existing categories; consider auto-clearing category_id on the vehicles when a category is deactivated (or at least a warning in the admin UI).

routes/admin.py admin_delete_vehicle_category correctly nulls category_id on affected vehicles — good. However admin_update_vehicle_category updates category doc even when body.vehicle_ids is None; that's the intended 'metadata-only edit' path but the JSDoc/testids ('vcat-vehicle-picker' visible in editor) suggest the picker is always sent. Confirm frontend always posts vehicle_ids (empty list included) so a user unchecking every checkbox actually clears assignments.

routes/player.py list_job_sectors + job_sector_detail filter jobs by 'visible_in_listings' TRUE (defaulting to True on missing key) — correct. Hidden jobs remain in db.jobs and are still fetchable by id (e.g. promotion path), so the requirement 'hiding must not block promotion' is honored. No mitigations needed.

seed_data VEHICLE_CATEGORY_MAP places every seeded vehicle into a category; there is no truly-uncategorized vehicle in fresh DB, so the 'Other Vehicles' virtual card in /vehicles will never render in a clean seed. This matches the task's 'may be uncategorized' note but is worth documenting in the UI copy so admins know how to force-render Other Vehicles (create an unassigned vehicle or delete a category).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (player /vehicles + admin Vehicle Categories + admin Job Sectors visibility)

Original category assignment was RESTORED via PUT with the original vehicle_ids list, and cleaner.visible_in_listings restored to true. Final DB state matches pre-test: 4 seed vehicle categories (cat_bikes/economy/utility/luxury) with 3/2/2/1 models assigned, cleaner Visible, sector_trades.job_count = 2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_vehicle_categories_and_job_visibility.py. Run with 'pytest backend/tests/test_vehicle_categories_and_job_visibility.py -o addopts= -v' (pytest.ini enables xdist; -o addopts= forces serial to avoid races). The Admin sub-tabs 'Vehicle Categories' and 'Job Sectors' live under MAIN tab 'City Infrastructure' (NOT Gameplay Tuning / NOT a group named 'Content'). The player Vehicle Dealer route is /vehicles. Cleaner's sector is sector_trades. Do NOT expect an 'Other Vehicles' card in a clean seed — every seeded vehicle is categorized. To force the 'other' card to render, temporarily delete a category (its vehicles become uncategorized and bucket into Other) — the CRUD test does this cleanup automatically. When toggling job visibility from the UI, DO NOT rely on /logout URL to switch users — the app auto-refreshes to the current session; use the browser LogOut button (top-right) or clear cookies. For end-to-end 'hide then verify player view' the fastest path is the direct API call as done in the pytest test.
